prediction.summary_1: The WEC 20 opponent in Mike Kyle’s bout was Brian Olsen, the last WEC heavyweight champion before Zuffa purchased the organization in 2006.
prediction.summary_2: Refuted. While the opponent at WEC 20 in Mike Kyle's bout was Brian Olsen, and he was indeed the last WEC heavyweight champion before Zuffa purchased the organization, the claim incorrectly states that the promotion company was founded in 2001 and purchased WEC at that time. According to the passages, Zuffa was founded in January 2001, but it did not purchase WEC until 2006.
